اقترفنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَفْنَا (iqtarafnā) /iq.ta.raf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# اُقْتُرِفْنَا (uqturifnā) /uq.tu.rif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
